description: Liste des gares à vélos is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Chazelles-sur-Lyon. Pour faciliter l’usage du vélo, la ville de Chazelles-sur-Lyon met à disposition des usagers de nombreux emplacements pour stationner les vélos en toute sécurité. Ces emplacements sont gratuits et situés à proximité du centre-ville et des lieux très fréquentés. Coverage: Ville de Chazelles-sur-Lyon. The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Chazelles-sur-Lyon. Its keywords include gares-a-velo, velo, mode-doux. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-01-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
